The '''Restricted Area''' was a lower level of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] inhabited by beggars and criminals. It could be accessed by a [[security door]] which would allow anyone to enter, but would only allow beings to exit by use of a passcode. Beings trying to exit who did not give the proper pass-code would have ten seconds to vacate the premises before the security door would activate [[autocannon]]s.

When [[Coruscant mercenary|mercenaries]] [[Skirmish at Coruscant|kidnapped]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], they took her to the Restricted Area. [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] had to enter it to rescue her. He learned that the current passcode was "Coruscant has lovely sunsets."

==Behind the scenes==
The Restricted Area appears in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The mission the district takes place in contradicts the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] film; Queen Amidala was not captured in the film.
